diagnostics.message: :module.csi: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit dependency from :module.csi to :module.eks is redundant: module.csi already has an implicit dependency on module.eks through attribute references such as module.eks.cluster.name and module.eks.oidc.

The Kubeflow Helm releases in :module.kubeflow use a local chart repository cloned by :resource.null_resource.clone, but the clone is outside Terraform's data-reference graph. :module.kubeflow should wait for the clone before reading that repository.

The cleanup provisioner in :resource.null_resource.clear removes kubeflow-manifests, while :resource.null_resource.clone creates that directory's contents. :resource.null_resource.clear should depend on :resource.null_resource.clone so cleanup cannot run before the clone.
